messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.

Hello, I renewed my annual plan on 3 September but my dashboard still shows the free tier and I cannot export reports. The receipt number is R-77813. Could you check what happened and restore my access? Thanks, Lena

response.text: Lena renewed her annual plan but still cannot access the dashboard or export reports, likely due to a billing issue.
